summary: In this excerpt from a fiction novel, the narrator and a PI named Tresting survive an attack in a ruined office, where four Korean gang members, all teenagers, lie dead. The narrator, who has a few shallow cuts from the glass, reflects on the youth of the dead and the violence, and Tresting thanks him for saving his life. They conclude the attack may have been carried out by Pithica, a group that does not want the incident investigated.
one_line: In a fiction excerpt, two investigators survive an attack in a wrecked office that leaves four young Korean gang members dead, and suspect Pithica is behind it.
key_facts: The narrator knows he has sustained five shallow cuts on his face, neck, and hands.
Tresting keeps his left hand pressed against a graze while crossing the glass-strewn floor.
Four dead teenagers, a girl and three boys, are probably around fifteen or sixteen years old.
The narrator says the dead are all Asian, and Tresting corrects him that they are Korean.
Tresting identifies the dead as gang members, pointing to a blood-smeared tattoo on one boy's hand.
The narrator recalls something about race riots and makes a mental note to ask the Internet about it.
Tresting says the attackers would have killed him, and that in this neighborhood the cops would have been too slow.
The narrator says 'They're kids' in a whisper, feeling like a monster.
Tresting says 'Something's different. First time Pithica's targeted me.'
Tresting recites that Korean gang members trying to hit a black PI in a bad neighborhood would be written off by cops as a hate crime.
Tresting reminds the narrator, 'You saw the data, Russell. Hell, you've been attacked.'
The narrator concludes that the attackers do not want the attack investigated.

entities.name: Tresting
entities.role: PI (private investigator) who is a black man, thanks the narrator for saving him, and suspects Pithica

entities.name: Russell
entities.role: narrator, who is addressed by name by Tresting and fought off the attackers

entities.name: Pithica
entities.role: suspected group that has targeted Tresting and may be behind the attack
